en.title: Register a Business in Rwanda
en.summary: Register a sole proprietorship or limited company through RDB or Irembo.

fr.title: Enregistrer une entreprise au Rwanda
fr.summary: Enregistrez une entreprise individuelle ou une societe a responsabilite limitee via RDB ou Irembo.

rw.title: Kwiyandikisha ubucuruzi mu Rwanda
rw.summary: Kwiyandikisha umucuruzi ku giti cyangwa sosiyete ya LLD binyuze muri RDB cyangwa Irembo.

summary: Register a sole proprietorship or limited company through RDB or Irembo.

text.en: Reserve your company name on Irembo or at RDB.
text.fr: Reservez le nom de votre entreprise sur Irembo ou a la RDB.
text.rw: Goreserwa izina ry'ubucuruzi kuri Irembo cyangwa ku biro bya RDB.

text.en: Prepare registration documents and pay the fee.
text.fr: Preparez les documents d'enregistrement et payez les frais.
text.rw: Tegura inyandiko zo kwiyandikisha wishyure igiciro.

text.en: Submit application and collect your certificate.
text.fr: Deposez la demande et retirez votre certificat.
text.rw: Saba ifomero uhabwe inyandiko y'kwiyandikisha.

whereToApply.description: RDB Head Office, Kigali, or online via Irembo

documentChecklist.fallbackOption: If no passport, national ID works
Get TIN first if you don't have one
Available at most photo studios in Kigali for ~2,000 RWF
Utility bill, tenancy agreement, or letter from village chief

physicalLocation.description: RDB Head Office, Kigali. Many services are also available at Irembo service centers.

taskBlueprint.culturalContext: Arrive early to avoid long queues. Dress neatly. Bring extra copies of all documents.

copyPasteScripts.text: Hello, I would like to register a business. What documents do I need?
Muraho, nshaka kwiyandikisha ubucuruzi. Ni inyandiko zikenewe?

taskBlueprint.introvertTip: Use Irembo online to skip queues. English is widely understood at RDB.

en.title: Apply for a National ID
en.summary: Get your Rwandan National ID through Irembo or your local sector office.

fr.title: Demander une carte d'identite nationale
fr.summary: Obtenez votre carte d'identite nationale rwandaise via Irembo ou votre bureau de secteur local.

rw.title: Gusaba Indangamuntu y'u Rwanda
rw.summary: Kubona Indangamuntu y'u Rwanda binyuze muri Irembo cyangwa ku biro by'umurenge wawe.

summary: Get your Rwandan National ID through Irembo or your local sector office.
eligibility: Residents with valid proof of identity

text.en: Visit Irembo.gov.rw or your local sector office.
text.fr: Visitez Irembo.gov.rw ou votre bureau de secteur local.
text.rw: Musura Irembo.gov.rw cyangwa ku biro by'umurenge.

text.en: Fill the application form and upload required documents.
text.fr: Remplissez le formulaire et telechargez les documents requis.
text.rw: Uzuza ifomero wo gusaba wohereza inyandiko zisabwa.

text.en: Collect your National ID at the appointed office.
text.fr: Retirez votre carte d'identite au bureau indique.
text.rw: Gura Indangamuntu yawe ku biro by'umurenge.

whereToApply.description: Online via Irembo or at your local sector office

documentChecklist.fallbackOption: Get from your local sector office if lost
Tenancy agreement, utility bill, or village chief letter
Available at photo studios in Kigali for ~2,000 RWF

physicalLocation.description: Local sector office or Irembo service center

taskBlueprint.culturalContext: Carry extra copies of documents. Arrive before 11 AM for faster service.
taskBlueprint.introvertTip: Apply online via Irembo to avoid in-person queues.

officialSource: Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration

en.title: Apply for a Rwandan Visa
en.summary: Apply for a tourist, business, or transit visa online or on arrival.

fr.title: Demander un visa rwandais
fr.summary: Demandez un visa touristique, d'affaires ou de transit en ligne ou a l'arrivee.

rw.title: Gusaba viza y'u Rwanda
rw.summary: Gusaba viza y'uruzinduko, ubucuruzi, cyangwa transit kuri interineti cyangwa igihe uje.

summary: Apply for a tourist, business, or transit visa online or on arrival.
eligibility: Passport valid for at least 6 months

text.en: Determine visa type and check requirements.
text.fr: Determinez le type de visa et verifiez les exigences.
text.rw: Menya ubwoko bwa viza kandi ube usabije ibisabwa.

text.en: Apply online via the immigration portal or on arrival.
text.fr: Demandez en ligne via le portail de l'immigration ou a l'arrivee.
text.rw: Saba kuri interineti binyuze muri portal ya immigration cyangwa igihe uje.

text.en: Pay the visa fee and collect your visa.
text.fr: Payez les frais de visa et retirez votre visa.
text.rw: Wishyure igiciro cya viza uhabwe viza.

whereToApply.description: Online at https://www.migration.gov.rw/ or at port of entry

documentChecklist.fallbackOption: Must be valid for at least 6 months
Required for all travelers

physicalLocation.description: Online or at port of entry

taskBlueprint.culturalContext: Have cash ready for visa fees at the airport. Keep documents handy for inspection.
taskBlueprint.introvertTip: Apply online before flying to skip queues at the airport.

en.title: Enroll in Mutuelle de Sante
en.summary: Join Rwanda's community health insurance at your local health center.

fr.title: S'inscrire a la Mutuelle de Sante
fr.summary: Rejoignez l'assurance maladie communautaire du Rwanda dans votre centre de sante local.

rw.title: Kwiyandikisha mu Mutuelle de Sante
rw.summary: Kwinjira mu ifatanyabikorwa ry'ubuzima bw'abaturage mu Rwanda ku kigo cy'ubuzima cya hafi.

summary: Join Rwanda's community health insurance at your local health center.

text.en: Visit your nearest health center (Centre de Sante).
text.fr: Visitez votre centre de sante le plus proche.
text.rw: Musura ikigo cy'ubuzima kiri hafi.

text.en: Provide your ID and proof of residence.
text.fr: Fournissez votre piece d'identite et preuve de domicile.
text.rw: Tanga indangamuntu n'igitabo cy'iwe.

text.en: Pay your contribution and receive your insurance card.
text.fr: Payez votre contribution et recevez votre carte d'assurance.
text.rw: Wishyure umusoro uhabwe ikarita y'umwanya.

fees.label: Annual contribution
fees.conditions: Income-based; often free or very low cost

documentChecklist.fallbackOption: National ID or passport
Tenancy agreement, utility bill, or village chief letter

taskBlueprint.culturalContext: Mutuelle covers most public health services. Bring your card whenever you visit a clinic.
taskBlueprint.introvertTip: Go early in the morning before 10 AM to avoid crowds.

en.title: Register for Tax with RRA
en.summary: Get a TIN and register for tax obligations through RRA online or in person.

fr.title: S'inscrire aux impots avec la RRA
fr.summary: Obtenez un TIN et inscrivez-vous aux obligations fiscales via la RRA en ligne ou en personne.

rw.title: Kwiyandikisha mu misoro ku RRA
rw.summary: Kubona TIN no kwiyandikisha ku misoro binyuze muri RRA kuri interineti cyangwa ku giti.

summary: Get a TIN and register for tax obligations through RRA online or in person.

text.en: Visit RRA website or office.
text.fr: Visitez le site web ou le bureau de la RRA.
text.rw: Musura urubuga rwa RRA cyangwa ku biro.

text.en: Fill TIN application form.
text.fr: Remplissez le formulaire de demande de TIN.
text.rw: Uzuza ifomero yo gusaba TIN.

text.en: Submit documents and receive your TIN.
text.fr: Deposez les documents et recevez votre TIN.
text.rw: Saba inyandiko uhabwe TIN.

whereToApply.description: RRA office or online via RRA portal

documentChecklist.fallbackOption: National ID or passport
Get from RDB first if not yet registered

physicalLocation.description: RRA offices in Kigali and major towns

taskBlueprint.culturalContext: Keep your TIN safe; you will need it for invoices, contracts, and bank accounts.
taskBlueprint.introvertTip: Register online via RRA website to avoid visiting the office.

en.title: Apply for a Birth Certificate
en.summary: Get a Rwandan birth certificate from your local sector office or via Irembo.

fr.title: Demander un acte de naissance
fr.summary: Obtenez un acte de naissance rwandais aupres de votre bureau de secteur local ou via Irembo.

rw.title: Gusaba inyandiko y'ivuka
rw.summary: Kubona inyandiko y'ivuka y'u Rwanda ku biro by'umurenge cyangwa kuri Irembo.

summary: Get a Rwandan birth certificate from your local sector office or via Irembo.
eligibility: Parents or legal guardians applying for children

text.en: Gather required documents and visit your local sector office.
text.fr: Rassemblez les documents requis et visitez votre bureau de secteur local.
text.rw: Tegura inyandiko zisabwa musure ku biro by'umurenge.

text.en: Fill the application form and pay the fee.
text.fr: Remplissez le formulaire et payez les frais.
text.rw: Uzuza ifomero ushure igiciro.

text.en: Collect your birth certificate.
text.fr: Retirez votre acte de naissance.
text.rw: Gura inyandiko y'ivuka.

whereToApply.description: Local sector office or online via Irembo

documentChecklist.fallbackOption: Get from the hospital where birth occurred
National ID or passport

taskBlueprint.culturalContext: Bring extra copies. Some offices require both parents to be present.
taskBlueprint.introvertTip: Apply online via Irembo where available.

en.title: Apply for a Rwandan Passport
en.summary: Apply for a new or renewed Rwandan passport at immigration offices or via Irembo.

fr.title: Demander un passeport rwandais
fr.summary: Demandez un nouveau passeport rwandais ou renouvelez-le aux bureaux d'immigration ou via Irembo.

rw.title: Gusaba pasiporo y'u Rwanda
rw.summary: Gusaba pasiporo nshya cyangwa kuyivugurura ku biro by'ubwivumbugashi cyangwa kuri Irembo.

summary: Apply for a new or renewed Rwandan passport at immigration offices or via Irembo.
eligibility: Holders of expired passports applying for renewal

text.en: Visit Irembo or the Directorate General of Immigration.
text.fr: Visitez Irembo ou la Direction Generale de l'Immigration.
text.rw: Musura Irembo cyangwa ku biro by'ubwivumbugashi.

text.en: Fill the application form and upload required documents.
text.fr: Remplissez le formulaire et telechargez les documents requis.
text.rw: Uzuza ifomero wohereza inyandiko zisabwa.

text.en: Pay the fee and collect your passport.
text.fr: Payez les frais et retirez votre passeport.
text.rw: Wishyure uhabwe pasiporo.

whereToApply.description: Directorate General of Immigration offices or online via Irembo

documentChecklist.fallbackOption: Required for identity verification
Required for first-time applicants

taskBlueprint.culturalContext: Wear formal attire for passport photos. Arrive early to avoid long queues.
taskBlueprint.introvertTip: Apply online via Irembo and track status digitally.

en.title: Apply for a Driving Permit
en.summary: Get a Rwandan driving permit through RDB after passing the driving test.

fr.title: Demander un permis de conduire
fr.summary: Obtenez un permis de conduire rwandais via la RDB apres avoir reussi l'examen de conduite.

rw.title: Gusaba uruhushya rwo gutwara
rw.summary: Kubona uruhushya rwo gutwara mu Rwanda binyuze muri RDB nyuma y'ikizami cy'uburyo bwo gutwara.

summary: Get a Rwandan driving permit through RDB after passing the driving test.

text.en: Attend a recognized driving school and pass the theory and practical tests.
text.fr: Inscrivez-vous dans une auto-ecole reconnue et reussissez les tests theorique et pratique.
text.rw: Jya mu ishuri ry'uburyo bwo gutwara ryemewe kandi umare ikizami cy'ibitekerezo n'icy'uburyo.

text.en: Apply for the permit at RDB with your test certificate.
text.fr: Demandez le permis a la RDB avec votre certificat d'examen.
text.rw: Saba uruhushya kuri RDB ufite icyemezo cy'ikizami.

text.en: Pay the fee and collect your driving permit.
text.fr: Payez les frais et retirez votre permis de conduire.
text.rw: Wishyure uhabwe uruhushya.

whereToApply.description: RDB offices or online via Irembo

documentChecklist.fallbackOption: National ID or passport
From a recognized driving school
From a certified clinic

taskBlueprint.culturalContext: Many driving schools in Kigali offer packages including the test. Shop around for prices.
taskBlueprint.introvertTip: Complete the theory test online if available, then book the practical test.

en.title: Get Home Internet in Kigali
en.summary: Compare and sign up for home internet from MTN, Airtel, or Liquid Telecom.

fr.title: Obtenir internet a la maison a Kigali
fr.summary: Comparez et souscrivez a internet domestique aupres de MTN, Airtel ou Liquid Telecom.

rw.title: Kubona internet mu rugo i Kigali
rw.summary: Gereranya kandi winjire mu internet y'urugo kuri MTN, Airtel, cyangwa Liquid Telecom.

summary: Compare and sign up for home internet from MTN, Airtel, or Liquid Telecom.

text.en: Compare providers: MTN, Airtel, Liquid Telecom.
text.fr: Comparez les fournisseurs: MTN, Airtel, Liquid Telecom.
text.rw: Gereranya abahawe serivisi: MTN, Airtel, Liquid Telecom.

text.en: Visit a provider store or website and choose a plan.
text.fr: Visitez un magasin ou le site web du fournisseur et choisissez un forfait.
text.rw: Musura iduka cyangwa urubuga rwa serivisi uhitemo forfait.

text.en: Provide ID and proof of residence, pay installation fee if any, and schedule installation.
text.fr: Fournissez votre piece d'identite et preuve de domicile, payez les frais d'installation et planifiez l'installation.
text.rw: Tanga indangamuntu n'igitabo cy'iwe, wishyure igiciro cy'installation maze ugenera itariki.

whereToApply.description: Provider stores in Kigali or online

documentChecklist.fallbackOption: National ID or passport
Tenancy agreement or utility bill

taskBlueprint.culturalContext: MTN and Airtel have the widest coverage. Liquid Telecom is stronger in office/business fiber.
taskBlueprint.introvertTip: Order online for home installation without visiting a store.
